name: oxipresso-vscode
description: Live incremental TeX preview driven by the Oxipresso render server (TeXpresso-style: millisecond edits, editor<->preview sync)

oxipresso.enginePath.description: Path to the oxipresso render-server binary (built from the oxipresso repo, real-engine mode)

oxipresso.renderScale.description: Page render density multiplier over 96dpi (2 = 192dpi, crisp on hi-dpi displays)

oxipresso.formatPath.description: Optional path to the texpresso.fmt engine format file (defaults to the binary's own resolution)
